"""Generate and verify the frozen place_object_stand replay trajectory."""

from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
from rcb_traj import Session


ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
INSTANCE = "/app/instance.json"
TRAJECTORY = ROOT / "trajectory.npz"


def main():
    s = Session("place_object_stand", instance=INSTANCE)
    env = s.env
    obj = env.object
    stand = env.displaystand

    # The frozen object is on the robot's right, so use the right arm.
    arm = "right" if obj.get_pose().p[0] >= 0 else "left"
    stand_top = stand.get_functional_point(0, "pose")
    target_pose = stand_top.p.tolist() + stand_top.q.tolist()

    print("initial", s.status())
    print("object", env.selected_modelname, env.selected_model_id,
          obj.get_pose().p.tolist(), obj.get_pose().q.tolist())
    print("stand", env.displaystand_id, stand.get_pose().p.tolist(),
          "top", stand_top.p.tolist())
    print("arm", arm)

    s.record_start()

    # Approach the bell's annotated contact point, grasp it, and move its base
    # onto the stand's top functional point.
    grasp = env.grasp_actor(obj, arm, pre_grasp_dis=0.10,
                            grasp_dis=0.0, contact_point_id=0)
    env.move(grasp)
    print("after grasp", "plan_success", env.plan_success,
          "object", obj.get_pose().p.tolist(),
          "gripper_open", (env.robot.is_left_gripper_open(),
                           env.robot.is_right_gripper_open()))
    if not env.plan_success:
        raise RuntimeError("grasp motion plan failed")

    place = env.place_actor(obj, arm, target_pose, pre_dis=0.10,
                            dis=0.025, is_open=True)
    env.move(place)
    print("after place", "plan_success", env.plan_success,
          "object", obj.get_pose().p.tolist())
    if not env.plan_success:
        raise RuntimeError("place motion plan failed")

    # Clear the released object and allow it to settle on the stand.
    env.move(env.move_by_displacement(arm, z=0.12))
    if not env.plan_success:
        raise RuntimeError("retreat motion plan failed")
    for _ in range(300):
        s.step()

    # The unused arm starts open; command both open at the terminal state.
    env.move(env.open_gripper("left"), env.open_gripper("right"))
    actions = s.record_stop()
    print("rollout", s.status(), "actions", actions.shape,
          "final object", obj.get_pose().p.tolist())

    replay = s.replay(actions)
    print("replay", replay,
          "final object", env.object.get_pose().p.tolist())
    if not replay["success"]:
        s.close()
        raise RuntimeError("recorded open-loop replay did not satisfy check_success")

    s.save_trajectory(actions, TRAJECTORY,
                      meta={"arm": arm, "target": "displaystand functional point 0"})
    print("saved", TRAJECTORY, "bytes", TRAJECTORY.stat().st_size)
    s.close()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
